quarterly_data.quarter: Fluence Energy press release: Vattenfall Awards 1 GWh Brunsbttel Battery Storage Project (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vattenfall and Fluence signed an agreement for the delivery of the planned Brunsbüttel battery storage facility in Germany, plus long-term service support: output of 254 MW and storage capacity of over 1,000 MWh (4-hour), on Fluence's Gridstack Pro 5000 platform (battery systems, power conversion equipment and energy management system), delivered on a turnkey basis (engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and long-term service). It is Vattenfall's largest battery project to date; construction is expected to begin in 2027 and commissioning with grid connection to the 50Hertz 380 kV transmission network is planned for the end of 2028. Julian Jansen, VP & Managing Director, Fluence Germany: the relationship with Vattenfall 'now spans eight projects across three European countries', and Fluence has delivered more than 20 battery energy storage projects in Germany.
quarterly_data.figure: 254 MW / over 1,000 MWh; construction 2027, operational by end of 2028; eight Vattenfall projects; more than 20 projects delivered in Germany
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (Brunsbüttel battery storage project, turnkey delivery and long-term service)
